title: ScreenCast
summary: 60fps wireless screen casting, mirroring & web console | 60帧无线投屏与网页控台
description:
Self-hosted web console (:8787) and 60 FPS wireless screen-casting & mirroring receiver for CardputerZero (320x170 RGB565). View a live 16-bit screen mirror in any browser, drag-drop or Ctrl+V paste images, switch among 10 built-in UI/photo/calibration test patterns, tune color modes and Bayer dither live, and lock stream frame pacing (1-120 FPS or unlimited) for smooth video playback and low-latency game casting via HTTP POST /push. Keys: 4/5 pattern, 6 color mode, 7 HUD tag, 8 En/Cn switch, tap ESC standby, hold ESC quit.

面向 CardputerZero（320×170 RGB565）的自托管双栏网页控台与 60 FPS 局域网无线投屏/同屏镜像接收应用。启动后浏览器访问设备 8787 端口即可查看实时屏幕镜像，支持拖拽或 Ctrl+V 粘贴截图直接上屏、一键切换 10 类内置 UI/照片/标定评估样张、实时调节色彩模式与 Bayer 防色带抖动，并提供 1–120 FPS 稳帧与不限速控制，可通过 HTTP POST /push 实现本地视频匀速播放与 60 FPS 游戏低延迟投屏。机身按键：4/5 切样张、6 切色彩、7 开关角标、8 中英切换、短按 ESC 回待机、长按 ESC 退出。
